query: How do I clean the debris filter on Samsung WA5471ABP?
ground_truth: Turn off the washing machine and unplug the power cord from the electrical outlet.
Open the filter cover located on the lower part of the machine.
Pull out the emergency drain tube and remove the cap to drain remaining water into a basin.
Replace the drain cap and re-insert the emergency tube.
Turn the debris filter cap counterclockwise and pull it out.
Wash any debris or foreign material from the filter with warm water and a brush.
Reinsert the debris filter and turn clockwise until securely locked.
Close the filter cover.

query: How do I run the calibration mode on Samsung WA5471ABP?
ground_truth: Make sure the washing machine is completely empty and powered off.
Press and hold the Delay End and Temp. buttons simultaneously, then press the Power button.
The machine will turn on and 'Cb' or calibration code will appear on the display.
Press the Start/Pause button to activate the Calibration Mode.
The tub will rotate clockwise and counterclockwise for approximately 2 to 3 minutes.
When complete, '0' or 'End' will display, and the machine will power off automatically.

query: How to remove and clean the detergent dispenser drawer in Samsung WA5471ABP?
ground_truth: Pull the detergent drawer out until it reaches its stop point.
Press down on the release lever located inside the softener compartment and pull the drawer completely out.
Remove the liquid detergent insert, softener insert, and bleach insert from the drawer compartments.
Wash all parts under warm running water using a soft brush to remove residue.
Clean the drawer recess in the washer housing using an old toothbrush.
Reassemble the inserts securely into their respective compartments.
Slide the dispenser drawer back into the machine until it clicks firmly into place.

task: Clean the water inlet mesh filter
query: How to clean water supply inlet mesh filters on Samsung WA5471ABP?
ground_truth: Turn off the hot and cold water supply taps completely.
Turn off and unplug the washing machine.
Unscrew the water inlet hoses from the back of the washing machine.
Using pliers, gently pull out the mesh filters from the inlet valves.
Rinse the mesh filters thoroughly under running water until all sediment is removed.
Reinsert the mesh filters securely back into the inlet valves.
Reconnect the water supply hoses and tighten the fittings.
Turn on the water taps and check for any leaks.

query: How do I level my Samsung WA5471ABP washer to stop shaking?
ground_truth: Place a carpenter's level on top of the washing machine (front-to-back and side-to-side).
Loosen the locking nuts on the leveling feet by turning them counterclockwise with a wrench.
Turn the adjustable leveling feet clockwise to lower or counterclockwise to raise the machine until perfectly level.
Ensure all four feet are firmly resting on the solid floor without rocking.
Tighten the locking nuts firmly against the bottom base of the washer using the wrench.

query: How to run the Pure Cycle or Self Clean tub maintenance on Samsung WA5471ABP?
ground_truth: Ensure the washer tub is empty and free of any laundry.
Press the Power button to turn on the washer.
Turn the Cycle Selector knob to select the Pure Cycle / Self Clean.
Do NOT add any detergent, bleach, or cleaning additives to the drum or dispensers.
Press the Start/Pause button to start the self-cleaning cycle.
Leave the washer lid open after the cycle completes to allow the tub to dry.

query: How do I turn on or turn off Child Lock on Samsung WA5471ABP?
ground_truth: Turn on the washing machine power.
Press and hold both the Temp. and Spin buttons simultaneously for 3 seconds.
The Child Lock icon will illuminate on the digital display when activated.
To deactivate Child Lock, press and hold the same two buttons (Temp. and Spin) again for 3 seconds until the icon turns off.

task: Troubleshoot unbalanced load error UE / dc
query: What should I do if Samsung WA5471ABP displays UE error or dc unbalance error?
ground_truth: Press the Start/Pause button to pause the cycle.
Open the washer lid.
Manually redistribute the laundry evenly around the perimeter of the tub.
If washing single heavy items (like a rug or blanket), add 1 or 2 smaller towels to balance the load.
Ensure the washer is standing level on all four feet.
Close the lid and press Start/Pause to resume the spin cycle.

query: How to resolve nd or 5E drain error code on Samsung WA5471ABP?
ground_truth: Turn off and unplug the washing machine.
Check that the drain hose is not kinked, bent, or pinched behind the machine.
Verify that the drain hose is not inserted more than 6 inches into the standpipe.
Check and clean the debris filter at the bottom front of the machine.
Ensure the drain pipe or household plumbing is not frozen or blocked.
Reconnect power and restart a drain/spin cycle.

query: How to fix nF or 4E water supply error on Samsung WA5471ABP?
ground_truth: Verify that both hot and cold water supply taps are fully open.
Check the water inlet hoses for kinks, sharp bends, or blockages.
Turn off the taps, disconnect the hoses, and clean the inlet mesh filters.
Ensure household water pressure is sufficient.
Check that water hoses are not frozen in cold weather.
Reconnect hoses securely, turn on taps, and restart the cycle.

query: How to properly install and connect the drain hose on Samsung WA5471ABP?
ground_truth: Guide the drain hose over the drain hose clip provided.
Position the end of the drain hose into the standpipe or laundry tub.
Ensure the end of the drain hose is between 39 inches (99 cm) and 96 inches (245 cm) from the floor.
Do not insert the hose more than 6 inches (15 cm) into the standpipe to prevent siphoning.
Secure the drain hose with a cable tie to prevent it from slipping out during pumping.

query: How to connect hot and cold water supply hoses on Samsung WA5471ABP?
ground_truth: Insert the rubber washers into the fittings at both ends of the water hoses.
Connect the red hose to the HOT water supply tap and the blue hose to the COLD water supply tap.
Tighten the fittings by hand until snug, then turn an additional 2/3 turn with pliers.
Connect the other ends of the hoses to the matching HOT and COLD inlet valves on the back of the washer.
Turn on the water supply taps fully and check for any leaks around all connection points.

query: How do I set the Delay End timer on Samsung WA5471ABP?
ground_truth: Load laundry into the tub and add detergent to the dispenser.
Press the Power button and select the desired wash cycle.
Press the Delay End button repeatedly to set the desired completion time (from 1 to 24 hours in 1-hour increments).
The display shows the set delay time.
Press the Start/Pause button to start the countdown timer.

query: Where and how do I add liquid chlorine bleach in Samsung WA5471ABP?
ground_truth: Locate the bleach compartment on the front left corner of the washer top.
Carefully pour liquid chlorine bleach into the bleach dispenser opening.
Do NOT exceed the MAX line indicated on the dispenser.
Do not use color-safe bleach in this compartment (add color-safe powder or liquid detergent directly with laundry).
Avoid splashing or overfilling to prevent fabric damage.

query: How do I add fabric softener in Samsung WA5471ABP?
ground_truth: Open the detergent dispenser drawer.
Pour recommended amount of liquid fabric softener into the softener compartment.
Do not fill beyond the MAX fill line to avoid premature dispensing.
Dilute thick or concentrated softeners with a small amount of warm water.
Close the dispenser drawer gently.

query: How to unlock the lid on Samsung WA5471ABP if it stays locked?
ground_truth: Press the Start/Pause button to pause the cycle.
Wait approximately 2 to 3 minutes for the lid lock safety mechanism to release.
Ensure the water temperature inside the tub is below 55°C and the tub has completely stopped spinning.
If water remains inside the tub, select a Drain/Spin cycle to pump out all water.
If power was interrupted, turn the power on and allow the machine to complete its reset sequence.

query: How do I winterize or protect Samsung WA5471ABP from freezing temperatures?
ground_truth: Turn off the water supply taps and disconnect the water inlet hoses.
Drain any remaining water from the hoses into a bucket.
Select a Spin cycle and run for 1 minute to empty remaining water in the pump.
Unplug the electrical power cord.
Open the lower filter door, pull out the emergency drain tube, and drain all water from the pump sump.
Leave the washer lid open to air-dry the interior tub.

query: How do I use the AquaJet feature on Samsung WA5471ABP?
ground_truth: Power on the washing machine.
Select an applicable wash cycle (such as Normal, Heavy Duty, or Bedding).
Press the AquaJet button on the control panel to activate powerful water jet spray.
Adjust desired temperature and spin speed options.
Press Start/Pause to begin the wash cycle with AquaJet rinsing active.

task: Clean the exterior and control panel
query: How to clean the exterior surface of Samsung WA5471ABP?
ground_truth: Unplug the washer before cleaning.
Wipe the cabinet and control panel using a soft damp cloth with mild non-abrasive household detergent.
Dry all surfaces thoroughly with a soft cloth.
Do NOT spray water directly onto the washer or control panel.
Do NOT use benzene, thinner, alcohol, or harsh abrasive chemicals.

query: What to do if Samsung WA5471ABP does not turn on or power up?
ground_truth: Check that the power cord is securely plugged into a grounded, live 120V AC electrical outlet.
Check the home circuit breaker or fuse box and reset if tripped.
Test the outlet with another appliance (like a lamp) to verify electrical supply.
Ensure the washer lid is completely closed.
Press and hold the Power button firmly for 1 full second.
